findings.title: SignalWire FreeSWITCH RCE (CVE-2026-116779)
findings.summary: A vulnerability in the handling of inbound SIP MESSAGE requests allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary FreeSWITCH API commands.

findings.title: OpenSSH 'SSHole' Auth Bypass (CVE-2026-123158)
findings.summary: A password authentication bypass exists in OpenSSH when used with musl libc without PAM.

findings.title: Plex Media Server 'Plex2Shell' (CVE-2026-96654)
findings.summary: A URL injection vulnerability allows attackers to call unauthorized plugin functions and supply custom parameters.

findings.title: Microsoft Paint RCE (CVE-2026-83844)
findings.summary: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Windows Paint could allow a remote unauthorized attacker to execute arbitrary code.
